svg.text: SHAWARMAN - the kebab stand cook
shawarman. The common enemy: a cook from a kebab stand. Realistic proportions (7.5 heads), 1.80 m, 230 px = 1 m. The outfit, not the face, says "kebab cook".
PALETTE
cook T-shirt #F2F2EE (red trim), apron #B8312A
tracksuit trousers #2A3350, nitrile gloves #4F8FD8
skin #D9A582 (vary per instance), hair #1F1812
DESIGN NOTES
* A real person: the night shift cook of the "Kebab & Parking" stand.
Realistic anatomy, about 7.5 heads tall. Tired, stern, heavy stubble.
* Kitchen kit: paper garrison cap with a red band, white T-shirt with
red trim, long red bib apron (grease and garlic sauce stains, logo,
pocket with a pen and a probe thermometer), blue nitrile gloves.
* Bazaar bottom half: tracksuit trousers with stripes, white sneakers.
* Weapon: a doner knife, 45 cm thin blade, always freshly sharpened.
A sharpening steel hangs at the back of the belt (idle anim: hones).
* Make 3-4 head and skin variants so a group of cooks is not clones.
* Rig: standard humanoid (UE mannequin compatible). Apron skirt: 2
cloth bones or cloth sim. Hat: rigid, can fly off on death. ~15k tris.
* HP 30, walks 2.4 m/s. Swing: 0.6 s windup, 0.9 m, 15 dmg.
Barks: "Fresh delivery!" "Garlic or spicy?" "Extra chicken!"
Death: falls flat on his back; a flatbread lands on his face.

g.text: Sees only 1.8 m ahead. Sneak up!
Plastic chair. Wakes only on noise.
Flatbread on the face, hat flies.
